Gassicourt is a district of Mantes-la-Jolie: the former village of Gassicourt, west of the old centre, was annexed to Mantes in 1930, the merged commune was called Mantes-Gassicourt until it was renamed Mantes-la-Jolie on 7 May 1953, and Gassicourt is one of the four districts of the city today (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mantes-la-Jolie; https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mantes-la-Jolie). A Nominatim read of the district centre lies 1.85 km west of the shared point, inside the commune; the 1944 claims name the whole town (Mantes-Gassicourt was its name then).
